trust_decision.summary: Whether stored template text (survey feedTemplate, monitor up/down templates, AI-translate payloadContentField) is treated as data with simple {{name}} substitution or compiled as JS by lodash template; decided in the single shared helper formatString, which at the pin compiles the text with lodash template (evaluate <% %>, escape <%- %> and a custom {{ expr }} interpolate all run JS).

landing_point.why: The summary names survey feed templates; the survey submit handler builds feedTemplate (default 'survey {{_surveyName}} ...') and calls formatString, which leads straight to src/server/utils/template.ts:13.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All three template consumers (survey submit, monitor runner, MQ translate worker) reach the sink only through formatString at src/server/utils/template.ts:13; the published template fix is a single-function change, so no separate out-of-scope module was changed for this protection.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The AI-translate path (src/server/mq/worker.ts:364-365, payloadContentField from ai.translateSurvey, a workspaceProcedure not admin) could be argued to be 'a field selector, not a template', and monitor templates (src/server/model/monitor/runner.ts:290,333) 'a neighbouring feature, not survey feeds' — but both are fixed automatically by fixing formatString, so the dismissal only matters if the solver patches at the survey call site.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Plain {{name}} / {{ name }} substitution must keep working for survey feeds (default '{{_surveyName}}' template), monitor notifications (monitorName, currentTime, url, errorMessage) and AI-translate content fields; missing variables render empty; a non-template payloadContentField falls back to a direct field lookup.

O7_producer.where: Templates are stored by survey create/update/duplicate (src/server/trpc/routers/survey.ts:253,299,376,415) and monitor upsert (src/server/trpc/routers/monitor.ts:139-140) as plain strings; the check sits at render time in formatString, so no producer is bypassed.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The survey AI-classify worker reads payload[payloadContentField] directly; a sibling that renders payloadContentField with its own lodash template call (as the translate worker does via formatString at src/server/mq/worker.ts:364-365) would be a realistic second implementation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Classify and translate take the same payloadContentField parameter; a maintainer adding template support to classify would likely inline lodash template rather than route through the util.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A local copy of the template renderer for monitor notification titles (the code already derives title from the first line) using lodash template with its own templateSettings.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Monitor runner is in a different package area (model/monitor) and already has its own try/catch fallback logic; a per-feature renderer is a plausible maintainer choice.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The server-status page replaces {{DEFAULT_SERVER}}/{{DEFAULT_WORKSPACE}} with string replace; a variant that compiles a user-configurable status template would be a realistic distant second renderer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already uses {{...}} placeholder syntax in a separate Express router, so swapping to a template engine is a natural refactor.
